findings.title: Neptune cluster without CloudWatch log exports
findings.description: Hygiene: Neptune clusters should export audit logs to CloudWatch. Set enable_cloudwatch_logs_exports (e.g. ["audit"]).
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.

findings.title: Neptune cluster not copying tags to snapshots
findings.description: A Neptune cluster with copy_tags_to_snapshot = false (the default) produces untagged snapshots, breaking cost allocation and data-classification tagging on backups. Set copy_tags_to_snapshot = true.
findings.remediation: Enable data protection. Turn on versioning / point-in-time recovery / automated backups with a retention period ≥ 7 days (30+ for production). Test restores regularly — untested backups are not backups.
